text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Doses of 2300 mg/kg in the rat and 2400 mg/kg in the mouse produced ataxia, convulsions, labored respiration and frequently death. Limited data indicate that CHEMET is dialyzable. In case of acute overdosage, consider use of induction of vomiting or gastric lavage followed by administration of an activated charcoal slurry and appropriate supportive therapy.
